messages:
Alan: FYI GigaNode just posted the manifest — 40x A100 80GB replacements. They're proposing two AWBs (AMS->LHR and FRA->SFO) and separate invoices. That's going to hit customs twice.
Mei: Do we have the PO number and which units are RMA vs new replacements? Can we force a single AWB? :thinking:
GigaNode-ops: PO RN-4821 covers 40 units. 28 replacements (RMA) + 12 expedited replacements. We can consolidate but vendor charges extra for cross-regional single-sku consolidation (~€1,600 extra leg).
Alan: What timeline if we consolidate to one AWB (EU -> US hub then split)? We need at least 24 GPUs in US within 10 business days to meet staging cutover.
Jordan: Current prod pool in us-west is at 92% reserved. If we don't get 24 by day 10 we'll have to throttle noncritical jobs. Can we accept partial air shipments earlier?
Ivan: I can arrange an express air from FRA to SFO for 16 units, transit ~4 days, cost +$16k. Remaining 24 can go sea/air mix, ETA ~14 days.
Mei: What's the customs risk splitting RMA vs new? Last time NL customs flagged separate invoices and held 8 units for 6 days.
GigaNode-ops: We can issue a consolidated commercial invoice (CIN) and flag items as 'replacement under warranty' to reduce duties. Need Redwood to sign a letter of noncommercial value — we can provide a template.
Alan: Send the template. Also confirm AWB numbers once booked.
procurement-bot: PO RN-4821 confirmed. Unit price €25,000, RMA credit pending upon receipt of faulty HW. Expedited surcharge applies: 8% if air.
Mei: Can we negotiate to waive the consolidation fee if we route 10 units to EU region and 30 to US? That avoids cross-hub handling.
GigaNode-ops: We can do 10 -> EU (AMS) + 30 -> US (SFO), two AWBs, but we'll provide a single consolidated invoice and CN22/RMA paperwork. No consolidation fee if split by region. :+1:
Jordan: Fine — route 10->eu-west-1 (ams), 30->us-west-1 (sfo). Ivan, can you handle SFO customs uplift and arrange temporary storage?
Ivan: Yes. I'll secure bonded warehouse at SFO for up to 3 days free, then $250/day per pallet. Need final AWBs and invoice by EOD tomorrow to lock transit slots.
Alan: Perfect. Mei, confirm cost delta and update capacity plan. We'll set a canary rollout to 10 nodes when the 10 EU units land.
Mei: On it — will post a cost delta summary shortly (air premiums, bonded storage, potential duty).
GigaNode-ops: AWB placeholders: `GBND1234567890US` (SFO) and `GBND0987654321EU` (AMS). We'll convert to final after payment confirmation.
Jordan: Thx. Also opening an incident ticket for potential capacity shortfall and tagging eng-sre.
Alan: Done — incident #INF-2025-77. Keep me posted. :shipit:
